purpose: bounded read-and-fix review of all canonical t(...) pairs in the Avatar of a Distant Sun unlock and recurring chat sections
note: Every canonical t(...) pair in the listed sections is in scope. No entry is asserted defective. Host source verification decides. args_order is recorded per call.

items.source: Uhh, okay. Sure. Mind showing me?
items.target: 啊，好的，行啊，不介意的话就展示给我看吧？

items.source:
<<<You feel a gentle warmth in your mind. Something speaks directly to your mind!>>>
#YELLOW#HELLO FRIEND. I AM A STAR FROM FAR AWAY. I HAVE HEARD YOU PRAISING YOUR SUN. WHY NOT PRAISE ME INSTEAD? I AM A MUCH BETTER SUN THAN THAT DULL, LIFELESS GAS ORB IN YOUR VICINITY. PLEASE, ALLOW ME TO DEMONSTRATE MY GOOD INTENTIONS.
items.target:
<<<你在脑海中感受到温暖，有什么东西直接在你脑海中对话！>>>
#YELLOW#你好啊朋友。我是一颗遥远的恒星。我听到了你赞美太阳的声音。为什么不赞美我呢？ 相比于你附近那颗了无生趣的气态球体，我作为太阳要好得多啊。可以的话，请允许我向你展示我的善意。

items.source: I don't take unsolicited messages from... stars.
items.target: 我不接受来自……星星的自荐消息。

items.source: #YELLOW#YOU ONLY HAD TO ASK, MY FRIEND.
items.target: #YELLOW#如你所愿，我的朋友。

items.source: #CRIMSON#[The area around you erupts in flames, burning your foes]
items.target: #CRIMSON#[火焰在你周围爆发，灼烧你的敌人。]

items.source: If you say so.
items.target: 如果你这么说的话。

items.source: Look, I appreciate the offer, but I don't know you.
items.target: 这些听起来挺不错，但我并不认识你啊。

items.source: #YELLOW#DON'T BE LIKE THAT. I KNOW YOU ARE ON A NOBLE QUEST.
items.target: #YELLOW#不要这样。我知道你正在进行一项崇高的使命。

items.source: I'm busy at the moment, so maybe call back another time?
items.target: 我现在很忙，能下次再谈吗？

items.source: #YELLOW#I AM YOUR FRIEND. NOW YOU KNOW ME. LET US BEGIN A LONG AND FRUITFUL FRIENDSHIP.
items.target: #YELLOW#我是你的朋友。现在你认识我了。愿我们的友谊天长地久，硕果累累。

items.source: #YELLOW#BUSY, YOU SAY? I CAN FIX THAT, LIKE ANY GOOD FRIEND WOULD.
items.target: #YELLOW#你现在很忙吗？我可以帮你解决手头的问题，就像好朋友一样。

items.source: #YELLOW#YOU DON'T BELIEVE ME? THEN PLEASE, ALLOW ME TO SHOW YOU A MERE FRACTION OF MY POWER.
items.target: #YELLOW#你不相信我？那么，请允许我向你展示我的部分力量。

items.source: #YELLOW#YOU ARE A CURIOUS ONE.
items.target: #YELLOW#你很有趣。

items.source: #YELLOW#YOU HAVE MADE THE RIGHT CHOICE. TOGETHER, WE SHALL BRING ABOUT THE DESTRUCTION OF OUR ENEMIES.
items.target: #YELLOW#你做出了正确的选择。让我们一起，为敌人带来毁灭。

items.source: #GOLD#[you are now an Avatar of a Distant Sun]
items.target: #GOLD#[你成为了遥远太阳的化身。]

items.source: Yes, give me your power!
items.target: 是的，请赐予我你的力量！

items.source:
<<<You feel the gentle warmth of your Distant Sun patron. It speaks directly to your mind!>>>
#YELLOW#I AM HERE. DO YOU DESIRE TO SMITE EVIL, DESTROY THE DARKNESS AND SCOUR THE EARTH? I SHALL AID YOU IN THIS QUEST. TOGETHER, WE WILL BE UNSTOPPABLE. ALL DARKNESS SHALL BE CONSUMED BY OUR LIGHT.
#LAST#
items.target:
<<<你感受到遥远太阳的温暖。它直接在你的脑海中对话!>>>
#YELLOW#我就在这里。你希望惩戒邪恶，毁灭黑暗，净化陆地吗？我会帮助你完成这项使命。我们联合，将无可阻挡。我们的光芒，将消灭一切黑暗。
#LAST#

items.source: Who... Who are you?
items.target: 你……你是谁？

items.source: But what are you getting out of this?
items.target: 但这样的话，你能得到什么呢？

items.source: That doesn't tell me anything.
items.target: 这相当于什么也没说。

items.source: But how are you speaking to me?
items.target: 你是怎么和我对话的？

items.source: #YELLOW#I AM YOUR FRIEND. IT IS GOOD TO HAVE FRIENDS, ISN'T IT?
items.target: #YELLOW#我是你的朋友。有朋友总是好事，对吧？

items.source: You still haven't told me who or what you are.
items.target: 你还是没有告诉我你是什么。

items.source: #YELLOW#YOU NEED NOT CONCERN YOURSELF WITH SUCH THINGS. I KNOW YOU CRAVE POWER. I KNOW THE WEIGHT OF THE WORLD IS ON YOUR SHOULDERS. SO, ACCEPT MY BOONS. ALLOW ME TO HELP YOU.
items.target: #YELLOW#你不需要关心这些小事。我知道你渴望力量。我知道你肩负着整个世界的重任。所以，接受我的恩惠吧。让我帮助你。

items.source: #YELLOW#I AM GETTING PLENTY OUT OF THIS.
items.target: #YELLOW#我从这件事中获益良多。

items.source: #YELLOW#I TIRE OF YOUR NAGGING QUESTIONS. TALK, TALK, TALK. YOU HAVE A SIMPLE CHOICE BEFORE YOU. WILL YOU BECOME POWERFUL? OR WILL YOU BE WEAK AND ALONE?
items.target: #YELLOW#你总是提出琐碎的问题。不断地说，说，说。在你面前有一个简单的选择。你要变强吗？还是要独自弱小？

items.source: I don't trust you. Please go away.
items.target: 我不相信你。请离开。

items.source: #YELLOW#I HAVE LITTLE PATIENCE FOR TIME WASTERS. THIS SHALL BE THE LAST TIME WE SPEAK.
items.target: #YELLOW#浪费时间。我不会再来找你了。

items.source: #GRAY#[prodigy point refunded]
items.target: #GRAY#[觉醒点返还。]
